groups.name: MCP original adapters and P3 recovery
groups.reason: The plain proof reader changes while collection/wait use adjacent original receipts and old recovery order.

groups.name: Current C01 host and public entry
groups.reason: The same provider source, profile custody, discovery/close and CLI/Web composition must continue working.

groups.name: Execution and result authority
groups.reason: Internal restored receive must preserve normal owner checks, late result usage, policy/currentness, validation and result reuse.

groups.name: Contract capture
groups.reason: The optional callback uses the existing tool/source snapshot and contract-version lifecycle.

groups.name: Workflow and persistent general turn
groups.reason: Recovery precedes a new reservation; completion, crash/reopen and a new answer must retain their existing sequence.

groups.name: Planning and compact ordering
groups.reason: A pending stored result must settle before automatic compact or a new model call, including context capacity boundaries.

groups.name: Disclosure
groups.reason: Reopening a stored result does not broaden the existing policy/disclosure surface.

excludedFromRelated: Unchanged C01 filesystem/setup/migration and C03 CRUD/UI suites remain covered by the later full suite.
General UI appearance, model registration/adapter and unrelated computer/board/A2A paths are not reselected without a changed dependency.
Collection/wait passing does not establish a new general-entry collection/wait implementation.
countsMeaning: File counts only. Actual TAP supplies test/pass/fail counts; these groups are not additive performance or quality evidence.
fullSuite: Discover all dist/tests/*.test.js only after the future exact-pin native build.
